sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Reckless Branch

system.description:
You channel explosive chakra into one of your striking limbs before striking the ground, causing an explosion, upturning the earth. All creature, excluding you in a 10-foot radius, centered on a point of your space, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 force damage and gain a rank of Dazzled or half as much damage on a success. The affected area is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn to all creatures, excluding you.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures who fail their save are pushed back 10-feet.
